paper_title: First results of the CERN Resonant WISP Search (CROWS)
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter chi, dimensionless, exactly as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 14
notes: CROWS is a microwave light-shining-through-wall experiment at CERN. It sets NEW limits on both hidden sector photons (chi = 4.1e-9 at m = 10.8 ueV, probing previously unexplored parameter space) and ALPs (g = 4.5e-8 GeV^-1 at m = 7.2 ueV; wideband g = 9.9e-8 GeV^-1). Following the pre-analysis hint and the fact that only the HSP result probes new parameter space, DarkPhoton was chosen. Only the single most-sensitive point is given numerically in the text; the full exclusion curves are in Figs. 13-14 but no table is provided. As an LSW experiment, no DM density assumption applies. The ALP result (AxionPhoton) is a separate limit not encoded here.
